name: Neon Synth Garden
plotTwist: The plants are the instrument: touching a leaf changes the pitch, and humidity made calibration a daily ritual.

name: Pixel Muralist
plotTwist: Hundreds of phones paint the same mural live; they solved pixel conflicts with a last-write-wins timestamp per cell.

name: Echo Drone
plotTwist: A drone that follows sound instead of GPS. Its first prototype chased the venue's air conditioner for ten minutes.
